notes.title: DeMagnete Update 1.05 released!
notes.content:
Hello and welcome back to DeMagnete VR!

We're back with new fixes and improvements to the gameplay! Check it out

[list]
[*] Added a new visual feedback when entering or exiting the boat using Continuous Movement

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EEnwlOh.gif[/img]

[*] Fixed an issue where the boat could move and leave you behind
[*] Fixed an issue where if you moved while the boat was moving the game would try to make you leave the boat
[*] Fixed some Vive Wand issues
[*] Ember Particles should not appear on Chapters 9, 10 and 11 anymore
[/list]

Let us know what you think and if you like the update, please leave a review! It REALLY helps us spread the word :D

** Achievement Spoiler Below **
(If you're trying to find the "Cara do Dani" achievement, you it's on Chapters 1 through 4 by interacting with a specific object in all those Chapters, the Achievement should unlock on Chapter 4)


Cheers!

notes.title: DeMagnete Update 1.04 released!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Hope you're all doing amazing! We've been hard at work here @ bitcake squashing all the bugs you've been reporting to us (thanks a ton!).

Here's the list:

Completely remade the Input System for SteamVR!
[list]
[*] Fixed all Valve Knuckles issues.
[*] Added new bindings for Knuckles, Wand and Touch (via SteamVR only).
[*] Left hand is used for movement, right hand is used for rotation.
[*] Fixed some interactions and improved input vibration feedback.
[/list]

Fixed issue where players using Continuous Movement couldn't get inside or outside of boats for some reason! (This fix is for both Oculus and SteamVR)

notes.title: DeMagnete Update 1.03 released!
notes.content:
Just a quick update!

[list]
[*] Fixed a major issue introduced on Patch 1.02 where players where being teleported to nowhere when entering an elevator.
[*] Fixed Graphics when playing with an Oculus Device (any of them). Previously no post effects were being rendered (fog, bloom, volumetric light, etc...) Should be fixed!
[/list]

notes.title: DeMagnete Update 1.02 released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First of all I want to thank all of you that bought the game and left a review, it really does help up a ton!
We've had a wonderful release week, with lots of love from all over the corners of the internet and the team has been overjoyed by it :D

So, after release we started to keep track of every bug you guys found and sent to us, we've compiled everything [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/995270/discussions/0/3056240606706039155/]in this post[/url], so please take a look there and please do leave your comments and feedback!

So on to the fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed Achievement for Completing Chapter 11 not unlocking
(You can just replay chapter 11 for this achievement to unlock)
[*] Fixed Achievement for Finding all Secrets not unlocking
(This achievement should unlock retroactively next time you open the game and has found all secrets)
[*] Fixed Achievement "Speed Run" not unlocking
[*] Fixed Snap Rotation not being correctly applied in the center of your head (this will lead to less sickness/dizziness, sorry!)
[*] Fixed a bug where you could hard lock the game on the last puzzle of Chapter 10
[*] Improved the last puzzle arrangement on Chapter 10 to make it more user-friendly
[*] Fixed some visual glitches
[/list]

Thanks again for being an amazing community!
You can always talk directly to the dev team on our [url=www.discord.gg/bitcake]discord.gg/bitcake[/url] so come and join!
